summary: This tool turns a WiFi 7 router into a 320 Msps software‑defined radio receiver using custom firmware and a Python API. It runs locally on the router hardware and is accessed via command‑line or Python calls. It is aimed at hobbyist ham‑radio enthusiasts and security researchers who need a cheap high‑speed SDR. Its standout strength is the cost‑effective, high‑performance conversion of consumer hardware, while its main caveat is the immature codebase and limited documentation.

sentiment.justification: The majority of comments praise the low cost and high performance of converting a WiFi 7 router into an SDR, highlighting its breakthrough nature for ham radio and signal analysis. Some users note the dense technical language and the project’s proof‑of‑concept limits, but overall sentiment is very positive with only minor nitpicks.
